note: Starting snapshot compiled from competitive results and community consensus through early 2026. The Beyblade X meta shifts fast — treat this as a baseline and use the community ratings below to keep it current.

blades.name: Dran Buster
blades.note: Premier upper-attack blade; heavy contact, high burst potential.

blades.name: Cobalt Drake
blades.note: Aggressive smash attacker, strong bank-shot recovery.

blades.name: Aero Pegasus
blades.note: CX-era attack standout with assist-blade options.

blades.name: Leon Claw
blades.note: Wide contact points, good burst attack.

blades.name: Wizard Rod
blades.note: Top stamina base; excellent life-after-death and recovery.

blades.name: Phoenix Wing
blades.note: Outspin monster with strong burst resistance.

blades.name: Knight Shield
blades.note: Benchmark defense blade; rounded, hard to burst.

blades.name: Golem Rock
blades.note: CX defense pick with heavy assist options.

blades.name: Hells Scythe
blades.note: Extremely versatile; stamina lean, great on many builds.

blades.name: Wyvern Gale
blades.note: CX balance with strong all-round stats.

blades.name: Cobalt Dragoon
blades.note: Balance attacker, fun but inconsistent top-level.

ratchets.note: Lowest common height; the attack standard.
Low + 9 protrusions; great grip and stability for attack/balance.
Low, 4 wide contact points; balanced attack option.
Low with minimal protrusions; smooth for stamina/attack.
Tall defense/stamina height; strong vs low attackers.

ratchets.name: M (Metal) variants
ratchets.note: Added weight low in the combo; strong for defense and outspin.

bits.name: Flat
bits.note: Fastest aggressive movement; the attack default.

bits.name: Rush
bits.note: Flat variant with a rubber rush tip; strong bank attack.

bits.name: Accel
bits.note: Rubber accel tip, aggressive with more control than Flat.

bits.name: Low Flat
bits.note: Lower Flat; faster, harder to control.

bits.name: Cyclone
bits.note: Rubber, moves in wide circles; good sustained pressure.

bits.name: Ball
bits.note: The stamina/defense benchmark; huge staying power.

bits.name: Point
bits.note: Tiny tip, maximum spin retention on a clean floor.

bits.name: Taper
bits.note: Between Ball and Point; balanced stamina.

bits.name: Needle
bits.note: Sharp tip, high stamina but tippy.

bits.name: High Taper
bits.note: Taller Taper; strong outspin vs low attackers.

bits.name: Bound Spike
bits.note: Spring-loaded tip; disrupts attackers and self-KOs less.

bits.name: Gear Ball
bits.note: Gear-driven Ball; extra burst and self-recovery.

bits.name: Hexa
bits.note: Six-sided low tip; stable against attack.

combos.note: The attack benchmark — commit to the bank shot.
Relentless rubber attack; strong vs stamina.
Premier stamina; wins the long spins.
Flexible balance answer to attack and stamina.
Tank build; survives the attack matchup.
